connectionTypes.sourceNote: LPDD tariff petition to JERC JKL for FY 2025-26 (Annual Performance Review/ARR & Tariff Determination filed 19-12-2024), "Proposed" tariff column, Non-Domestic/Commercial Metered, single-phase (PRIMARY government filing, https://cdnbbsr.s3waas.gov.in/s395192c98732387165bf8e396c0f2dad2/uploads/2025/04/202504182075644073.pdf). This is the petitioner's proposed tariff, not confirmed as JERC's final approved order — no separately extractable final order text was found (LPDD's own tariff PDF at lpdd.ladakh.gov.in is a scanned image with no machine-readable text). Three-phase connections are billed flat at Rs.6.00/kVAh with fixed charge Rs.154/kVA/month, not modelled here.

LPDD tariff petition to JERC JKL for FY 2025-26, "Proposed" tariff column, LT Industrial Supply, LTIS-I (connected load <50kW) (PRIMARY government filing, https://cdnbbsr.s3waas.gov.in/s395192c98732387165bf8e396c0f2dad2/uploads/2025/04/202504182075644073.pdf). Proposed, not confirmed final. Rates quoted per kVAh, represented here as Rs./kWh. Connections >=50kW pay the same energy charge with a fixed charge of Rs.69.55/kVA/month instead.

LPDD tariff petition to JERC JKL for FY 2025-26, "Proposed" tariff column, Agriculture Metered, 0-10 HP tier (PRIMARY government filing, https://cdnbbsr.s3waas.gov.in/s395192c98732387165bf8e396c0f2dad2/uploads/2025/04/202504182075644073.pdf). Proposed, not confirmed final. Energy charge is tiered by sanctioned HP: 0-10 HP = Rs.1.00/kWh, 11-20 HP = Rs.1.50/kWh, above 20 HP = Rs.5.50/kWh; fixed charge is a flat Rs.40/HP/month across all tiers, converted here to Rs./kW using 1 HP = 0.746 kW.
